_comment: icraft #35 Cataclysm boss-only Tetra material (refight-to-repair). REPAIR ITEM = cataclysm:ignitium_ingot, which drops ONLY from Ignis (soul_black_smith, Nether, T3 -- drops x3 per kill). Ignitium is a fire themed metal: high primary, deliberately LOW durability (950) so the item wears down -- and since ignitium_ingot has no other source, the ONLY way to repair an ignitium-built Tetra item is to refight Ignis. UPGRADED 2026-06-01 (icraft #35): was an early weak entry (520 dur / iron tool / single-asterisk attrs); raised to T3 boss-tier stats matching the cm_* set and converted attrs to ** (MULTIPLY_TOTAL) per the lessons-learned-Tetra hard rule -- single-* silently zeroed these. Tools + armor.
